text: SABECO introduces 333 Triple Pure through immersive consumer experience

HCM CITY - Saigon Beer-Alcohol-Beverage Corporation (SABECO) has launched 333 Triple Pure, its latest product, as part of its ongoing efforts to respond to changing consumer preferences and lifestyles.
The new beer was introduced at an immersive brand experience at Thủ Thiêm Riverstage in HCM City.
The event invited consumers to explore how the long-established Vietnamese beer brand is evolving to suit changing tastes and social occasions.
"At SABECO, innovation starts with understanding how consumers and their lifestyles are evolving.

333 Triple Pure translates these insights into a product that brings together our brewing expertise, a contemporary format and the quality drinking experience consumers expect from 333," said Patsy Lim, deputy general director in charge of marketing at SABECO.

"More than simply adding another beer to the shelf, 333 Triple Pure opens up opportunities to connect with consumers who prefer a lighter taste and take part in a broader range of drinking and social occasions, while driving the next chapter of growth for 333.
Presented in a compact 250ml can, 333 Triple Pure combines the brand's brewing heritage with a contemporary product and convenient format.
SABECO says the beer is designed to offer a refined taste and a lighter drinking experience.
Triple filtration and triple hopping give the product its smooth, refined taste, while it contains less carbohydrates and fewer calories than standard 333 beer, according to the company.
The product reflects SABECO's efforts to respond to evolving preferences while preserving the drinking experience associated with the brand.
The event used visual displays, sensory elements and storytelling to showcase the brewing process and product features.
Guests learned about the craftsmanship behind 333 Triple Pure before sampling the beer.
The launch comes as consumers seek products suited to a wider range of lifestyles and social occasions, without compromising on quality, taste or brand experience.
SABECO says it is combining its brewing heritage with consumer insights to develop its portfolio and keep its brands relevant.
The immersive event demonstrated how the company is applying innovation across product development and consumer engagement, drawing on its brewing expertise and understanding of local consumers.
SABECO has a brewing legacy spanning more than 150 years.
The company operates a network of 26 breweries and a distribution system reaching hundreds of thousands of retailers nationwide.
